tools.name: add-tasks
tools.description: Create one or more Todoist tasks with content, description, priority, due date, duration, labels, project, section, parent and assignee.

tools.name: find-tasks
tools.description: Find tasks by search text, project, section, parent, responsible user or label name.

tools.name: find-tasks-by-date
tools.description: Find tasks due on a date or within a date range, including overdue tasks.

tools.name: find-completed-tasks
tools.description: List completed tasks within a date range.

tools.name: update-tasks
tools.description: Update existing tasks: content, description, priority, due date, labels, project, section or parent.

tools.name: complete-tasks
tools.description: Mark one or more tasks as completed.

tools.name: uncomplete-tasks
tools.description: Reopen one or more completed tasks.

tools.name: reschedule-tasks
tools.description: Move tasks to a different due date while preserving recurrence.

tools.name: add-projects
tools.description: Create one or more projects.

tools.name: find-projects
tools.description: List or search projects.

tools.name: update-projects
tools.description: Update project names, colors, favorite status or view style.

tools.name: project-management
tools.description: Archive or unarchive a project.

tools.name: project-move
tools.description: Move a project between personal and workspace.

tools.name: add-sections
tools.description: Create sections within a project.

tools.name: find-sections
tools.description: List sections in a project.

tools.name: update-sections
tools.description: Rename or update sections.

tools.name: add-labels
tools.description: Create personal labels.

tools.name: find-labels
tools.description: List or search labels.

tools.name: update-labels
tools.description: Update labels.

tools.name: add-comments
tools.description: Add comments to tasks or projects, optionally notifying named users.

notifyUsers.description: Users to notify about the comment.

tools.name: find-comments
tools.description: List comments on a task or project.

tools.name: update-comments
tools.description: Edit existing comments.

tools.name: add-reminders
tools.description: Create time-based or location-based reminders on tasks.

tools.name: find-reminders
tools.description: List reminders on tasks.

tools.name: update-reminders
tools.description: Update reminders.

tools.name: add-filters
tools.description: Create saved filters.

tools.name: find-filters
tools.description: List or search saved filters.

tools.name: update-filters
tools.description: Update saved filters.

tools.name: manage-assignments
tools.description: Assign, reassign or unassign tasks to collaborators in bulk.

tools.name: find-project-collaborators
tools.description: Find collaborators of shared projects, or resolve a person's name or email to a user ID.

searchTerm.description: Name or email to look up.

tools.name: find-activity
tools.description: List activity log events such as task completions, filtered by object type, event type, initiator and date range.

tools.name: get-overview
tools.description: Get an overview of the user's workload, projects and progress.

tools.name: get-productivity-stats
tools.description: Get productivity statistics: karma, completed counts and streaks.

tools.name: get-project-health
tools.description: Get the health status of a project.

tools.name: analyze-project-health
tools.description: Refresh and analyze a project's health.

tools.name: get-project-activity-stats
tools.description: Get activity statistics for a project.

tools.name: get-workspace-insights
tools.description: Get insights across a workspace's projects.

tools.name: list-workspaces
tools.description: List the Todoist workspaces the user belongs to.

tools.name: user-info
tools.description: Get the current user's ID, name, email and timezone.

tools.name: fetch-object
tools.description: Fetch a single task, project, comment or other object by ID, optionally with its children.

includeChildren.description: Include subtasks and other child objects.

tools.name: delete-object
tools.description: Delete any Todoist object by type and ID.
